# bourse

`bourse` is the market-data connector of the ORCHESTRA analytics
framework: it fetches cryptocurrency market data (OHLCV candles, order
books, 24-hour tickers) from public exchange APIs and emits it as a
contract-typed, provenance-labelled result. It is the trading-domain
counterpart of the `terroir` geo-data collector.

Every external fact – a symbol, a price tick size, a fee, a column’s
unit – is recorded in a provenance registry and treated as
**unverified** until it has been diffed against the exchange’s own
catalogue (the Independent Oracle Principle). An ungrounded fact
triggers a refusal rather than a silently wrong number. For a trading
system that is risk control, not bookkeeping: an unverified tick size or
fee is a number that loses money.

`bourse` supplies market data only. It gives no financial or trading
advice.

## Related packages

- [cryptoQuotes](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=cryptoQuotes)
  returns OHLC market data from major cryptocurrency exchanges as `xts`
  series, with sentiment indicators and interactive charts.
- [crypto2](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=crypto2) downloads
  cryptocurrency information and daily historical prices from
  CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko.
- [binancer](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=binancer) is a client
  for the Binance public REST API, for data collection, portfolio
  management and trading.

bourse reads Binance’s public endpoints too, but each result carries the
grounding status of the facts it rests on (symbol, tick size, fee,
units), checked against the exchange’s own catalogue, and it returns a
refusal instead of a value when a fact has not been checked.

## Installation

``` r

pak::pak("max578/bourse")
```

## Usage

Each verb returns either a grounded result object or a `bourse_refusal`.
Here we parse recorded fixtures offline (the live path uses the
suggested `httr2`).

``` r

library(bourse)

candles <- cbind(
  open_time = c(1.5e12, 1.5e12 + 86400000),
  open = c(100, 102), high = c(105, 106), low = c(99, 101),
  close = c(102, 104), volume = c(1200, 1500))

bourse_ohlcv("BTCUSDT", interval = "1d", candles = candles)
#> <market_series> BTCUSDT @ binance [1d]  2 rows  [[unverified]]

bourse_orderbook("BTCUSDT", depth = list(
  bids = list(c("100.0", "1.5")), asks = list(c("100.1", "1.0"))))
#> <order_book> BTCUSDT @ binance  1 bids / 1 asks  [[unverified]]

bourse_ticker("BTCUSDT", ticker = list(
  symbol = "BTCUSDT", lastPrice = "100.0", openPrice = "98.0",
  highPrice = "101.0", lowPrice = "97.0", volume = "1200",
  quoteVolume = "118800", openTime = 1.5e12, closeTime = 1.5e12 + 86400000))
#> <market_ticker> BTCUSDT @ binance  last=100  24h=NA%  [[unverified]]
```

A result is `[unverified]` until the catalogue-diff oracle has grounded
the facts it rests on; a consumer on a live order path gates on the
grounding label.

## Grounding: the catalogue-diff oracle

[`bourse_catalogue_diff()`](https://max578.github.io/bourse/reference/bourse_catalogue_diff.md)
is the only operation that grounds a fact. It diffs the asserted facts
against the exchange’s own `/exchangeInfo` catalogue and grounds those
that agree with a real date. By default it grounds the multi-symbol core
universe (`BTCUSDT`, `ETHUSDT`, `BNBUSDT`, `SOLUSDT`).

``` r

bourse_fact_status("binance")
#>    source n_facts n_grounded n_unverified
#> 1 binance      10          0           10
```

## Known gap: the fee schedule

`bourse` reads public, anonymous endpoints only. The maker/taker
**`fee_schedule`** is sourced from the authenticated
`/sapi/v1/asset/tradeFee` endpoint, which would introduce an
API-credential surface; it is deliberately not implemented. That fact
stays `[unverified]` in the registry rather than substituting a
documentation default the package cannot diff against the account’s
actual fee tier. See `SECURITY.md`.

# Package index

## Market-data verbs

The data verbs. Each returns a grounded result object or a refusal,
never a number it cannot stand behind.

- [`bourse_ohlcv()`](https://max578.github.io/bourse/reference/bourse_ohlcv.md)
  : Fetch or parse an OHLCV market series
- [`bourse_orderbook()`](https://max578.github.io/bourse/reference/bourse_orderbook.md)
  : Fetch or parse an order book
- [`bourse_ticker()`](https://max578.github.io/bourse/reference/bourse_ticker.md)
  : Fetch or parse a 24-hour ticker

## Result objects

The contract-typed S7 result objects and the refusal outcome.

- [`market_series()`](https://max578.github.io/bourse/reference/market_series.md)
  : A grounded market series
- [`order_book()`](https://max578.github.io/bourse/reference/order_book.md)
  : A grounded order book
- [`market_ticker()`](https://max578.github.io/bourse/reference/market_ticker.md)
  : A grounded 24-hour ticker
- [`bourse_refusal()`](https://max578.github.io/bourse/reference/bourse_refusal.md)
  : A refusal
- [`is_refusal()`](https://max578.github.io/bourse/reference/is_refusal.md)
  : Is this object a refusal?

## Grounding (the Independent Oracle Principle)

The provenance machinery: the catalogue-diff oracle, the external-facts
registry, and the canonical grounding vocabulary.

- [`bourse_catalogue_diff()`](https://max578.github.io/bourse/reference/bourse_catalogue_diff.md)
  : Diff asserted facts against the exchange catalogue
- [`bourse_external_facts()`](https://max578.github.io/bourse/reference/bourse_external_facts.md)
  : The external-facts provenance registry
- [`bourse_fact_status()`](https://max578.github.io/bourse/reference/bourse_fact_status.md)
  : Grounding status of the external facts
- [`fact_grounding()`](https://max578.github.io/bourse/reference/fact_grounding.md)
  : Grounding token for a fact family
- [`grounding_grounded()`](https://max578.github.io/bourse/reference/grounding_tokens.md)
  [`grounding_unverified()`](https://max578.github.io/bourse/reference/grounding_tokens.md)
  : Canonical grounding tokens
- [`combine_grounding()`](https://max578.github.io/bourse/reference/combine_grounding.md)
  : Combine grounding worst-case

## Package

- [`bourse`](https://max578.github.io/bourse/reference/bourse-package.md)
  [`bourse-package`](https://max578.github.io/bourse/reference/bourse-package.md)
  : bourse: Grounded Market-Data Connector for the ORCHESTRA Framework
